item.title: Ice cream van, 1st August
item.description:
A local ice-cream van is going down our road up to six times a day. Yesterday it came down 4 times in an hour. It habitually parks outside my home and in this hot weather with the windows open fills my room with fumes. The noise from it's music is so loud it blots out the sound of the television.

item.title: Junction of Floyd Road and Charlton Church Lane, 1st August
item.description:
Yes it's the fly tip AGAIN: overflowing Biffa bins plus bags of rubbish all around. This has been going on for MONTHS and no one is tackling the issue. Yesterday (31 July) there were so many bags that they had piled up and were obscuring the street name. This morning (1 August) the bags had toppled down and covered the entire footpath so that people had to walk in the road. It is boiling hot. The rubbish STINKS. Now please get this shifted and take action to stop whoever these anti social dumpers are. If I didn't pay my council tax RBG would be on me like a ton of bricks so kindly get a move on here.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Charlton Church Lane, Charlton
Report on FixMyStreet
